description: 大規模崩塌潛勢區警戒值 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 提供大規模崩塌潛勢區警戒值，包含County(縣市)、Town(鄉鎮)、LSNo(大規模崩塌崩塌編碼)、Name(大規模崩塌區名稱)、AlertValue(雨量警戒參考值)、Lng(經度)、Lat(緯度)。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, xml. The portal shows 2025-08-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
